recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It completes the published decision in build-scope source without broadening the version-mixing policy or adding redundant guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-20912 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the HTTP FHIR Version Parameter. It requested replacing the absolute error on mismatched Accept and Content-Type fhirVersion values with an exception for operations specifically defined to perform version conversion, such as $convert, and cleaning up the $convert examples.
initial_application: Commit 639dbcd2848776be444488fe66b23438c581256d initially applied FHIR-20912 by changing source/http.html to allow the operation-defined version-conversion exception and correcting the $convert request example. Later operation cleanup split the $convert examples into request and response files; later HTTP wording edits touched the same paragraph but left a typo and broken parenthetical.
additional_context: source/http.html is the authoritative HTTP narrative page, and Resource is active in source/fhir.ini. source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-convert.xml references the $convert request and response example files through build example extensions. Zulip discussion and FHIR-I minutes confirm the intended policy was narrow: only operations that define version conversion, with $convert as the known core example, may use different Accept and Content-Type versions.
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html to say "this page" and to close the $convert parenthetical after the link. Changed source/resource/$convert-response.txt to refer to the Content-Type header instead of the nonexistent Content-Header.
source_changes: source/http.html: fixed the Jira-reported "ths page" typo and closed the $convert parenthetical in the fhirVersion exception sentence.
source/resource/$convert-response.txt: corrected the $convert response example comment from "Content-Header" to "Content-Type header".
